• Collaborate with project managers, team members, technical teams, and stakeholders to monitor, develop, and implement

projects.name: and associated content.
details: • Track project milestones and deliverables.
• Implement and monitor key milestones and relevant KPIs to assess project progress.
• Provide regular updates to management and project sponsors, organize periodic reviews, and prepare documentation to communicate progress.
• Identify and address issues and conflicts within the program, projects, project management community, and with stakeholders
as necessary.
• Resolve issues at the project or line level, escalating unresolved matters as appropriate.
• Promote the adoption of agile methodology across teams.
• Develop the best practices and tools for project execution and management.
• Ensure the use of standards and practices across all projects.
Client Service Group
• Led the North CSG team, overseeing performance, service levels, and ensuring full compliance with TAT for client queries
across all channels.
• Managed internal and external stakeholders; coordinated with clients, Relationship Managers, and Transaction Banking Sales
to align expectations and drive operational improvements.
• Served as Premier Service Manager at Standard Chartered Bank, managing major corporate accounts.
• Monitored unit risks and processes, conducted monthly Key Control Standard checks, and reported exceptions.
• Delivered online solutions for daily transaction banking activities and resolved client queries on channels, trade, and cash
management.
• Managed top global corporate and financial institution clients as their dedicated contact.
• Promoted a client-centric culture, handled escalations, managed workflow, and enhanced client experience.
• Trained and developed new team members.
Core Banking Payment & Operations
• Overseeing all requests and inquiries related to the issuance of Demand Drafts (DDs), Pay Orders (POs), ICFTs, stop payments,
transfers, clearing activities, and other associated services.
• Handling requests and inquiries for both local and foreign currency outward and inward telegraphic transfers.
• Managing requests and inquiries related to RTGS, electronic payments, and similar transactions.
• Supervising processes for account opening, signature verification referrals, and signature updates for corporate accounts.
• Addressing general inquiries and calls pertaining to all banking transactions, including remittances, EFT, stop payments, cash
deliveries, collections, pick-ups, and trade-related matters. Maintaining daily and weekly tracking of pending issues and
monitoring the aging of unresolved cases.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to address service requirements, inquiries, and instructions.
Key Achievements/Awards/Recognitions
• Service Excellence Awards.
• Multiple ‘Manager Choice’ Awards for contribution in delivering quality Services.
• Star Award for maintaining the highest standard of Customer Satisfaction and Retention.
My Strengths:
• My managerial skills, ability to work under pressure & handle complex issues independently enable me to bring confidence
in my team.
• Stakeholders Management & Collaborative approach.
• Positive frame of mind, attitude to learn and openness to accept challenges make me a competitive person.
• Committed & hard-working team player with flexible approach and ability to take initiative whenever required.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
